findings.description: Sprouts Farmers Market is to take the former Nordstrom Rack space in this South of Market building, opening in 2028 as the grocer's first San Francisco store.

citation.label: SFist, “Sprouts Market Plans First SF Store at Former Nordstrom Rack Site on Ninth Street,” 28 August 2026

raw.text: Sprouts Farmers Market is moving into the former Nordstrom Rack at 555 Ninth Street

publish.note: Timeline entry on /san-francisco/south-of-market/9th-street/525/, which already existed. EAS puts 525, 555 and 559 09TH ST on parcel 3781003, so per the directory contract the fact belongs on the page at the lowest number, not the 555 the story prints.

resolution.method: EAS exact match on 555 09TH ST → parcel 3781003; sf-parcels has blklot 3781003 active, 525–559 09TH; the 2025 roll records it as commercial retail, built 1991. EAS puts 525, 555, 559 09TH ST on that parcel, so per the directory contract the fact belongs on one page at the lowest, 525.

findings.description: Sergeant Ma, a restaurant, is due to open in this former industrial building across Third Street from Oracle Park in about two weeks. Cass Calder Smith is named as the designer of the interior fit-out.

citation.label: SFist, “Sergeant Ma, a New China Basin Restaurant With Chinese and Vietnamese Flavors, Opens In Two Weeks,” 27 August 2026

raw.text: The space is in a former industrial building across Third Street from Orac[le Park]
